supplied_material: ROI event ordering: on every posedge, if reset then clear; otherwise decode both bridge samples; if start_seen && !end_seen, call observe_cycle first; then process valid commit lane0 followed by lane1. A start PC increments start_hits, first start sets start_seen/start_lane and primes intervals active on boundary as left_censored; repeat start is invalid. An end before start is invalid; first end after start sets end_seen/end_lane and finalizes; repeat end is invalid. Thus qualified window is edge-old S+1..E; start lane0/end lane1 same edge has zero cycles and complete=false.

Probe ABI per bridge: state[3:0], active kind/token/epoch, station valid/kind/token/epoch, request valid/fire/kind/token/epoch, aw_complete=(aw_done_q||aw_fire_w), w_complete=(w_done_q||w_fire_w), bvalid, stage_advance, bit38 station_cancel=station_drop_terminal_w, bit39 active_drop=active_drop_terminal_r, bit40 response_fire=mem0_rsp_valid_o&&mem0_rsp_ready_i. One DPI call also carries both commit valid/PC and both ROB-head live tokens, avoiding cross-always DPI ordering dependence.

Legal states S0..S12: IDLE,WALK_AR,WALK_R,READ_ADDR,READ_DATA,WRITE_REQ,WRITE_RESP,RESP,AD_UPDATE,LOOKUP,DEVICE_WAIT,OWNER_HOLD,SQ_QUERY. Encoded S13..S15 retain their state buckets but increment invalid_events. operation class uses active state8=>A_D_UPDATE else kind 0/1/2=>LOAD/STORE/ATOMIC; kind3 while valid is invalid.

Stages: admission_wait=request_valid until request_fire; reservation=station_valid until stage_advance or station_cancel; translation=states1/2/8; write_request=state5 until AW and W complete; write_response=state6 until B/response; aw_w_to_b=state6 or state8 after AW/W complete until B; sq_query=state12. Owner changes within an active stage increment invalid. station_cancel and active_drop close as cancelled and never enter normal bins; response/B closes normally. A/D AW/W completion plus B on the same first active sample closes aw_w_to_b in bin0; other observed active samples increment duration before close.

Boundary rules: stages active on S are left_censored and excluded from normal histograms; eligible stages still active after E sample are right_censored; complete bins only contain eligible normal completions. Conservation per bridge/stage/class is eligible_started=completed+right_censored+cancelled, left_censored=left_completed+left_right_censored, sum bins=completed. Per bridge sum state S0..S15 cycles=ROI cycles; write-inflight occupancy 0/1/2 bridges sums to ROI cycles. Any overflow/invalid, missing or duplicate marker, zero ROI, or broken conservation makes complete=false.

ROB-head correlation compares only the live head token because NpcSimTop exposes a uniqueness-qualified head memory token; contract names this rob_head_token_correlation, not full kind/epoch correlation. Peer overlap requires both bridges active with unequal full kind/token/epoch. B terminal count records every bvalid in state6/state8; no event dedup exists.
